Messages.Author: ashur@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
What cards are affected by Ravnos Carnival? Only action card-actions or
all actions that require a card? What rule prevents for example
equipment-actions to be affected? Thanks.

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
ashur@hotmail.com wrote:
> What cards are affected by Ravnos Carnival? Only action card-actions or
> all actions that require a card? What rule prevents for example
> equipment-actions to be affected? Thanks.

All cards that are an action are considered "Action Cards".  Cards whose Most
Recent Printing have the <> symbol on them.
This includes basic "action cards", Political Actions, Equipment, Retainers, 
and Allies (and Powers, but Ravnos Carnival can't assist with those for obvious
reasons).
